questions.stem: State Gauss's lemma for the Legendre symbol and use it to compute (2/p).
solution_steps: Gauss: (a/p) = (−1)^μ where μ counts residues of a·1,…,a·(p−1)/2 exceeding p/2.
For a=2 this count gives (2/p) = (−1)^((p²−1)/8).
So 2 is a QR iff p ≡ ±1 (mod 8).
